modules.title: Semantic HTML5 & Accessible Forms
modules.subtitle: Write meaningful markup that screen readers, SEO, and Playwright love.
modules.summary: Replace div-soup with semantic landmarks (`<main>`, `<nav>`, `<article>`) and properly associated `<label for=...>` inputs.

sections.title: 1.1 Why Semantic Elements Matter
sections.body: Using `<button>`, `<nav>`, `<main>`, and `<label for="email">` gives you built-in keyboard navigation, focus handling, accessibility roles, and rock-solid Playwright `getByRole()` selectors for free.
sections.code_example: Sign In

spec.question: Which attribute on `<label>` explicitly connects it to `<input id="username">`?
spec.explanation: `for` matches the input's `id`, making clicking the label focus the input and enabling `page.getByLabel(...)` in Playwright.
spec.hint: In React JSX this becomes `htmlFor`, in plain HTML it is shorter.

modules.title: Modern CSS: Flexbox & Grid Layout
modules.subtitle: Center anything and build responsive multi-column dashboards cleanly.
modules.summary: Know when to pick 1D Flexbox vs 2D CSS Grid, and write clean responsive layout rules in Neovim.

sections.title: 1.1 Flexbox (1D) vs Grid (2D)
sections.body: Use **Flexbox** (`display: flex`) for a single axis (navbars, button rows, centering a card). Use **CSS Grid** (`display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr))`) for responsive two-dimensional card grids with zero media queries!

activities.title: Participation Activity: Perfect Centering in Flexbox

spec.prompt: Fill in the two Flexbox properties that center a child horizontally and vertically.
spec.explanation: `justify-content: center` aligns along the main axis and `align-items: center` aligns along the cross axis.

modules.title: React Rendering, Immutable State & Functional Updates
modules.subtitle: Avoid stale closures and render clean UI from pure state.
modules.summary: Trace React state batching, understand why `setCount(c => c + 1)` beats `setCount(count + 1)` in batched updates, and build a pure React component in Neovim.

sections.title: 1.1 Batched Updates & Functional Updaters
sections.body: Inside a single event handler, `count` stays fixed to the snapshot from the current render. Calling `setCount(count + 1)` three times only increments by 1! Passing an updater function `setCount(prev => prev + 1)` queues each increment on the latest state.

spec.prompt: Starting from `count = 5`, trace the value after each click handler finishes re-rendering.
spec.explanation: React snapshots state per render; functional updaters (`c => ...`) always chain off the latest queued value.

modules.title: Playwright Locators, Auto-Waiting & Live E2E Automation
modules.subtitle: Write flake-free browser tests using user-facing role locators.
modules.summary: Prefer `getByRole` and `getByLabel` over brittle CSS paths, and automate a live fixture page directly from Neovim!

sections.title: 1.1 Resilient Locators & Auto-Waiting
sections.body: Brittle selectors like `div > div:nth-child(3) > span` break on any layout tweak. Playwright's `page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Run' })` and `page.getByLabel('Prompt')` mirror how real users interact and automatically wait for elements to become actionable.

spec.question: Which Playwright locator is recommended as the #1 priority for clicking a visible 'Deploy' button?
spec.explanation: `getByRole('button', { name: 'Deploy' })` tests both accessibility semantics and user-visible text without hardcoded sleeps.
spec.hint: Playwright prioritizes ARIA role + accessible name.
